title: Merge overlapping intervals
description: Given a list of intervals as [start, end] pairs, merge every pair that overlaps and return the resulting list. Intervals that merely touch, such as [1,4] and [4,5], count as overlapping. Input order is not guaranteed and output order does not matter.
hint: Sort by start. Walk the list keeping the current interval open, extending its end while the next start is not past it, and closing it otherwise.
